notes.title: Small Demo Update
notes.content:
Patch Notes - Demo Update
This update addresses several smaller issues reported since the demo launch.



Fixes:

Minor visual and interaction bugs resolved

Small gameplay inconsistencies corrected

General stability improvements



Development is also ongoing on a major rework of the movement system, which will be the focus of the next significant update.

Thank you to everyone who has played the demo and shared feedback - your reviews are very helpful as the game continues to improve.

notes.title: STEAM DEMO
notes.content:
Zomb Zerro 999 – Demo Launches August 25


We’re excited to announce that the demo for Zomb Zerro 999 will be available on August 25 - right here on Steam!



Explore. Investigate. Survive.

In this story-driven VR horror experience, you’ll step into the boots of Sam Keller, a technician trapped deep inside a secret mountain facility where a failed experiment - and something far older - now stirs.



The demo offers a first glimpse into the dark world of Zomb Zerro 999, featuring:

    Atmospheric exploration

    Environmental storytelling

    Puzzle-solving and early narrative beats

    A hint of the danger to come...



Add the game to your wishlist to be notified as soon as the demo goes live.



Thanks for all the support - and stay tuned for more updates as we approach launch.

- Marcus

Apex Aurora Games
